|translation='''Title:''' Death brand.

'''Card text:'''
Use 3 Force to deploy on an exterior planet site. Target an opponent's smuggler. Each turn, at the start of the opponent's control phase, the opponent loses 1 Force. When the target reaches the Utinni Effect, the Utinni Effect is canceled and the target is placed in the Used Pile.

'''Lore:'''
"Living with a death mark is no small thing. Solo, you're an excellent fighter. It hurts to lose you."
